Hi,


Tests in HackerRank remain active indefinitely unless a start and end time are set. 
Without these, tests do not expire automatically.



To set expiration times, specify a start and end date/time in the test settings. After expiration:

Invited candidates cannot access the test.
The "Invite" button is disabled; no new invitations can be sent.


To check or change expiration settings:

Go to the test's Settings and select the General section.
Update the Start date & time and End date & time fields as needed.
To keep the test active indefinitely, clear these fields by clicking the clear icon (X).


If the test has an expiration set, adjust these settings to enable new invitations.

 have a different test?

Hi,


Consider these guidelines when choosing between creating a new test or a variant:



When to Use Test Variants:

Create variants to adapt a single test to different candidate profiles, 
such as roles with different tech stacks (React, Angular, Vue.js).
Variants streamline assessments by showing candidates only relevant sections and generating role-specific reports.


Advantages of Test Variants:

Reduces the need to manage multiple tests, improving efficiency.
Decreases maintenance while allowing scalable personalization.
Ensures candidates are tested on relevant content.


Disadvantages and Limitations of Test Variants:

A test must have at least two variants to function; you cannot delete a variant if only two exist.
Variants without logic are hidden from candidates until logic is added.
detailed_results.predicted_response:
### Overview

Test variants are designed to streamline your assessment process by allowing you to manage multiple versions of a test within a single, unified setup. This is particularly useful when assessing candidates across different tech stacks (e.g., Node.js, Python, or Java) for the same role.

### When to Use Test Variants

Use test variants when you want to assess candidates for the same core role but need to offer different technical options. Instead of managing separate tests, you can create a single test with multiple variants. Candidates select their preferred stack at login, and they only see the sections relevant to them.

### Advantages of Test Variants

- **Reduced Maintenance:** Manage one test setup instead of multiple individual tests.
- **Clean Reporting:** Reports are specific to the variant attempted, ensuring insights remain role-specific and easy to evaluate.
- **Personalized Experience:** Candidates receive context via subtext for each variant, helping them make informed decisions before starting.
- **Scalability:** Simplifies the process of personalizing assessments at scale.

### When to Create a New Test

Create a new, separate test when you are assessing for a distinct job role, different skill sets, or varying experience levels that do not share a common assessment structure. 

### Notes

- A variant-based test requires at least two variants to be configured.
- You can view and manage roles (default or custom) when creating a new test or scheduling an interview.

### Reference

- [Test Variants](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/3121307537-july-2025-release-notes)
- [Create Test Variants](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/7530103378-test-variants)

### Overview
To provide a candidate with extra time, you do not need to reinvite them. You can modify the duration directly within your HackerRank for Work account. If the candidate has already submitted the test, you may need to reinvite them as a new attempt.

### Steps to Add Extra Time
1. Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account.
2. Go to the **Tests** tab and select the relevant test.
3. Navigate to the **Candidates** tab.
4. Select the checkbox next to the candidate.
5. Click **More > Add Time**.
6. Enter the additional time in minutes (e.g., 53) and click **Confirm**.

### Notes
- If the candidate is currently taking the test, they must refresh their page to see the updated timer.
- If the candidate has already completed the test, they must log in again to view the added time.
- If the test contains DevOps questions and has already been submitted, the virtual machine is purged. In this specific case, you must reinvite the candidate to take the test as a new attempt.

### Reinviting a Candidate
If a new attempt is required:
1. Go to the **Tests** tab and open the test.
2. Navigate to the **Candidates** tab.
3. Select the candidate and click **Invite selected**.
4. In the **Send Test Invites** section, click **Send invite**.
5. When prompted, click **Re-invite** and then **Send invite** to confirm.

Reference: https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/4811403281-adding-extra-time-for-candidates
